sentences.en: His career prospects at the company are not too promising.
sentences.zh: 他在这个公司的职业前景并不太乐观。

sentences.en: He has a very promising career as a Berber teacher.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名柏柏尔语教师有着非常光明的职业前途。

sentences.en: Let me introduce a promising young writer to you.
sentences.zh: 让我向你介绍一位很有潜力的年轻作家。

senses.zh: 承诺，答应；使很可能，预示（promise 的现在分词形式）
